Population increased in Lancashire

The estimated population of Lancashire in 2024 was 1,294,914 usual residents, a rise of 1.6% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Lancashire increased by 4.7%.

Age profile of Lancashire

The average (median) age fell to 42.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Lancashire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, Lancashire's population of 1,294,914 usual residents was made up of:

  • 230,529 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.8%)
  • 791,545 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.1%)
  • 272,840 people aged 65 years and over, (21.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Lancashire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Lancashire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Lancashire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Lancashire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 2,447 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 11,627 births and 14,074 deaths in Lancashire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 10,666 (0.8%). There were 58,086 people entering the area and 47,420 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Lancashire's population of 11,463 (0.9%) as a result of 17,510 people entering the area and 6,047 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Lancashire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Lancashire in mid-2023 is 1,275,103.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 3,725 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,216 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 4,941 people.
